name: YJ MGC Beta 3x3 Aero (Magnetic, MagLev, UV Coated)
description: The YJ MGC Beta 3x3 Aero (Magnetic, MagLev, UV Coated) is the cloud-feel build of the MGC Beta line — a lightweight 72g magnetic speed cube with a zero-resistance MagLev core and dual-adjustment tuning that lets you dial in both tension and magnet distance by hand. If you want a floating, effortless turning feel without the extra heft, this is the one.
features: Floating MagLev feel: Repelling magnets replace the springs for a zero-resistance, silky turning motion that stays consistent solve after solve.
Lightweight at 72g: A multiple-hollowed, weight-reduced core and pieces keep the cube light and agile in hand.
Tune it to your hand: 6 levels of tension and 5 levels of magnet distance, all adjustable by hand — no tools, no guesswork.
Stickerless and ready to solve: Comes set up out of the box with a clean stickerless finish, so you can start turning right away.
Dual-adjustment system: Outer ring sets tension across 6 levels; inner ring sets magnet distance across 5 levels.
Manual adjustment: The 5-level setup adjusts by hand, so you can fine-tune the feel between loose and locked without disassembly.
